{{Article header|deck=A gemstone cargo commodity extracted through planetary surface mining with the Rhino.}}

{{Callout|type=tip|label=Quick answer|1='''Ruby''' is obtained through [[Surface Mining|planetary surface mining]] with a [[Rhino]]. EDFM's prospecting observations have found it most often on volcanic magma ground, with additional observations on metal-rich, high-metal-content, volcanic silicate, and rocky ground. Use the table below for current observed rates and [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]] for the extraction procedure.<ref name="ruby-inara">[https://inara.cz/elite/commodity/10501/ Ruby — Commodity], INARA.</ref><ref name="rhino-update">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-1-0 Elite Dangerous — 4.4.1.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments.</ref>}}

{{Commodity infobox|ruby}}

'''Ruby''' is a gemstone cargo commodity introduced in update 4.4.1.0 alongside the [[Rhino]] and planetary surface-mining system.<ref name="rhino-update" /> INARA classifies it as a mineral, lists it as produced by surface mining, and describes its value in jewellery, fashion, and manufacturing.<ref name="ruby-inara" /> It occupies cargo space rather than the separate [[Engineering Materials]] inventory.

== Acquisition ==

Ruby can be recovered from Planetary Mining Locations using a [[Rhino]]. A ship's [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] identifies suitable locations from orbit, after which the Rhino searches for and extracts buried deposits.<ref name="rhino-update" /><ref name="rhino-devlog">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments.</ref>

EDFM's current community prospecting dataset records Ruby on several ground types. These figures are observed occurrence rates from surveyed mining locations, not Frontier-published spawn rates or guaranteed yields. They do not establish that the listed ground types are exhaustive.

{{#invoke:EDFM/SurfaceMining|material|ruby}}

See [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]] for equipment, prospecting, rig deployment, refining, and collection instructions. Ruby-specific deposit yield, refining conversion, capacity, and replenishment behavior have not yet been established.

=== Buying ===

Normal NPC production or purchase supply has not been established. Commodity services may display a reference buy price while reporting no actual stock, so confirm current supply, report age, landing-pad access, and carrier permissions before travelling.<ref name="ruby-inara" />

== Uses and selling ==

{{Commodity uses|ruby}}

Ruby can be sold to commodity markets with demand. INARA lists Tourism, High Tech, and Industrial economies as consumers.<ref name="ruby-inara" /> Market prices and demand change, so check a current [https://inara.cz/elite/commodity/10501/ commodity-market listing] before choosing a buyer.
